description: Simulates an EVM transaction execution without broadcasting: { chain, from, to, data, value }. Returns eth_call output, gas estimate, success/revert status with decoded revert reason (Error(string), Panic(uint256)), and token balance if to is an ERC-20. State overrides not supported by public RPCs. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: Target EVM chain name (e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum)

value.description: Optional value in wei (hex or decimal string)

name: evm_simulate
title: Evm Simulate
